label: Inquiry and closure at the root: does the PSR presupposed by inquiry reach a root's absences?
summary: #2145 horizontal lane H2. Tested whether the PSR in the forms the graph ties to inquiry (#755, #756) reaches a necessary root's intrinsic and negative profile facts. Certificate inquiryScopeMap [a3d7403d]: every inquiry-tied form (ContingentPSR, NoBrute, TrackingBridge, SupportCoverage, EvidenceBridge, GlobalDefeat, the skeptical-alternative presupposition NoBruteEvidenceAlternative, ReasonIndependent, IrreflexiveContingent) is invariant under any change of reasons at targets not contingent at the world of evaluation, and the skeptical mechanism has no purchase on a necessary hypothesis, so the contingency restriction is set by the mechanism; under N every root lack is necessary and the family is blind to its reasons; admitting the necessary truths as reasons for the necessary truths meets FactPSR wherever ContingentPSR holds and keeps every quality condition, so the scope extension is cheap; WorkIndependent at every reason, the one quality condition that reaches necessary targets, gives every explained necessary truth a contingent reason, for both roots. Separated two senses of explained absence (new disambiguation bb604f7b: EXPLAINED_ABSENCE_1 admitted reason, _2 positively fixed). Registered: FactPSR strengthens the PSR for root lack facts [d0040551]; that PSR, the lack facts, the sense bridge a8a43166 and the necessity direction 89c988d9 give E [93dfa140]; E alone gives the bridge [a7644793] (relocation); the PSR, the lack facts, the reason-essence thesis fedc67d8, LE and 89c988d9 give E [1844def4]; essential exclusion of root absences b2d6ac16 strengthens the reason-essence thesis [3452ca1e]; b2d6ac16, LE and 89c988d9 give E without N or EM [915d06fd]. Lean-only clauses: profile-sound complete knowledge of root lacks gives E (the epistemic candidate is a completeness demand); the reference-class assumption binds both roots. E is used in the graph only for fe67d766, so rejecting it undermines no attribute inference the rival uses. Controls: each premise of each route fails alone with E failing; the rival with profile {esse, a, b} meets N, the lack facts, FactPSR at both worlds, every quality condition, every #756 bridge and the unrestricted GlobalDefeat while E and the bridge fail; the base arena with no reasons for lacks meets every contingent-scoped condition; on lane E's classical selection carrier XN, LE, MG and E hold while N fails.
blocker: No inquiry premise supplies the step from an admitted reason to a positively fixed absence: it is the sense bridge (equivalent to E given cheap premises) or the reason-essence thesis with LE. LE at a pure root remains the shared bottleneck (lane E's reference-class objection). Strongest standing rival: the impersonal eminent source with a necessary lack of noesis, the full inquiry stance, and a bare negative clause (denies LE) or a nature-less necessary lack (denies XN) as admitted reason. Next: an argument for LE from the unity of a simple being; XN on the powers account; whether a selection is a real determination (#555); register WorkIndependent at necessary targets as a rival quality standard.

current_assessment.scope: E (no unexplained absence at actual roots) and carriage LE against the PSR in the forms the graph ties to inquiry (#755, #756), applied symmetrically to the impersonal and the classical root (#2145 lane H2). Scoped to a rival whose lack of noesis is case (iii).
current_assessment.assessment: The inquiry family gives E and LE no independent warrant; this fourth angle on E relocates to LE. Every inquiry-tied PSR form is blind to reasons at necessary targets, and its contingency restriction is principled by the skeptical mechanism itself. Extending the scope to a necessary root's lack facts is cheap in the admitted-reason sense (necessaryReasons), and the rival with the full inquiry stance and the unrestricted fact PSR keeps E false. The step from an admitted reason to E's positively fixed absence is the sense bridge, equivalent to E given cheap premises, or the reason-essence thesis with LE and the necessity direction 89c988d9. The epistemic reading of closure is E as a completeness demand on knowledge of the root's profile, which no inquiry needs; E supports no attribute inference the rival uses. Symmetrically, the inquiry family reaches the classical root's contingent selection (met by its exercised power) and not the necessitarian impersonal root's lacks, and a uniform extension is met cheaply by both. The new route from essential exclusion of root absences, LE and 89c988d9 drops N and EM: it is open to the powers account and does not cost the classical root N on lane E's selection carrier; its load is LE and 89c988d9, shared with lane E's route. Lane E's judgment on E (conditional support of low to moderate strength; nothing established) is unchanged.
